### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **12** documentable anchor(s).

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx`  _(via sendTemplate (literal, a string literal on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/kernel/index.mdx`  _(via sendTemplate (literal, a string literal on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/email-service.mdx`  _(via sendTemplate (literal, a string literal on a changed line))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx`  _(via resolveLocalizationContext (symbol, a top-level function), sendTemplate (literal, a string literal on a changed line))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **49** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ec7e15abcb66afd638932b68e0ce4bc1b17bb313` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9274bc7f848902c588b1d8bcf7f3c7632d7c9145` — the merge of head `eb1c3932176dc9aab7cce58b1558289d706e0640` into base `ec7e15abcb66afd638932b68e0ce4bc1b17bb313`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9274bc7f848902c588b1d8bcf7f3c7632d7c9145 && git checkout 9274bc7f848902c588b1d8bcf7f3c7632d7c9145
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ec7e15abcb66afd638932b68e0ce4bc1b17bb313 eb1c3932176dc9aab7cce58b1558289d706e0640 && git checkout -B drift-repro ec7e15abcb66afd638932b68e0ce4bc1b17bb313 && git merge --no-ff eb1c3932176dc9aab7cce58b1558289d706e0640

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ec7e15abcb66afd638932b68e0ce4bc1b17bb313
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ec7e15abcb66afd638932b68e0ce4bc1b17bb313` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Seat ACCEPT · PR #28088 · head `eb1c3932176dc9aab7cce58b1558289d706e0640` · 2026-10-30T12:38Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 两处把「设置读失败」误当成「组织没设默认币种」的地方改正：① 核心本地化解析里，组织探测因存储故障失败时，答案也带 `readFailed`，消息通道据此重试，不再永久丢信（#27733）；② 认证类邮件（验证、重置密码、邀请等）读币种失败时，若模板因此缺默认币种而拒绝，改为抛可重试的错误，不再报 `TEMPLATE_INVALID` 和「请设置 localization.currency」（#27710）。
- **为什么改：** 一次瞬时存储故障会让邮件被判为永久失败，并给出错误的修复建议。
- **风险与回滚：** 读成功且确实没有默认值的情形完全不变；探测失败的答案不进任何缓存，下次请求重新读。回滚即还原 core 与 plugin-auth 的改动。自动化 notify 的同类问题需要改 engine.ts，已拆到 #28056。
- **先看：** `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts` 的 `localizationFallbackReach`，和 `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/mail-tenant-currency.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** 跑 `resolve-localization-read-failed.test.ts` 与 `mail-tenant-currency.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的：** 无（Tier S，按本期落地授权由席位落地）。

## 席位核对

- **Shape:** draft → main, `Fixes #27733`, `Fixes #27710`. 7 files (+487/−40): core resolver + a new test; plugin-auth `mail-tenant-currency.ts`, its wiring in `auth-plugin.ts`, two test files; one changeset. `check-governed-merges --pr 28088`: NOT governed.
- **Premises:** both re-measured on `main` @ `bc496bf7` by the thread (the probe leg mapped `AuthzStoreUnavailableError` to `unowned` with no `readFailed`; the mail resolver returned `.currency` and ignored `readFailed`).
- **Graded rules:** #27733 per triage 6509207804 — a probe store fault answers `readFailed: true` and writes **no** memo (the entry it superseded is dropped; a non-store throw still says nothing more); pinned at the resolver and through one messaging channel. #27710 per triage 6506866652 for the `plugin-auth` caller — a failed read is transient, never "no default"; a read that succeeds and finds none keeps today's refusal. The `XXX` trial render (never sent) keeps a template refusal a default cannot cure standing.
- **Scope split:** #27710's `service-automation` leg needs the held `engine.ts` resolver contract, `run-resume.ts` and `builtin/template.ts`; moved to #28056 (body says so, with the three measured reasons). `Fixes #27710` is right: #28056 owns that row.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no` (no shape change: `readFailed` gains a trigger; the new resolver helper is not on `plugin-auth`'s entry), `Metadata-protocol: none`; `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth` `patch`.
- **Local (card thread):** six ablations red then restored; core 2878, plugin-auth 3896, service-messaging 756 passing; typecheck and `pnpm lint` exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` 69/69.
- **Gate check-runs on this head:** 48 total, 38 success, 10 skipped by the path filter, 0 failed. `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **Landing:** Tier S, under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (2026-10-29 22:05Z, seat thread). Ready + auto-merge through the relay.

**ACCEPT**
